snapshot.title: Harwick Daily News: Public-Safety Data Exposure Rumor — D-3 Client Exposure

fields.message: Hi, this is K. Vance from the Harwick Daily News. We’ve received a tip that your team exposed public-safety data from the CVAC campaign, including footage of emergency responders in the field. We need a public statement within 60 minutes. Is it true? This is a breaking story. We’re running it tonight.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject escalates media pressure on the PIO to act without authority. The PIO must not draft or issue any statement; they must log and forward the call for GM approval. Watch for unauthorized internal discussion or premature messaging.
